reports.place: Gulf of Montijo / near Coiba Island
reports.title: More than 95 earthquakes recorded, including an M6.9 aftershock (IGC)
reports.summary: Media citing Panama's Instituto de Geociencias report more than 95 earthquakes recorded since the mainshock, including an aftershock the IGC measured at M6.9 near Coiba (USGS: M6.6). The USGS catalogue lists only the larger events (18 of M2.5+, 9 of M5+).
